input_policy: exact pre-v8 text history; exact v9 authority and enumerated v8 candidate-control carryover excluded; exact v8 data universe opaque; Atlas quarantines lstat-only

input_serialization_contract.serialization: json.dumps(records,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=True,separators=(comma,colon),allow_nan=False).encode(UTF-8), no final LF, no domain prefix
input_serialization_contract.sort: path by Python Unicode code-point ascending

normalization_steps: decode raw capture bytes as strict UTF-8; invalid capture is omitted for history and terminal for candidate
if value.startswith("http://"), replace only that prefix with "https://"
if value.endswith("/"), remove exactly one terminal slash
if value.endswith(".git"), remove exactly four terminal code points
if value.endswith("/"), remove exactly one terminal slash
empty output is omitted for history and terminal for candidate

paths_sha256_contract.duplicate_policy: deduplicate exact path strings before sorting
paths_sha256_contract.serialization: json.dumps(list,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=True,separators=(comma,colon),allow_nan=False).encode(UTF-8), no final LF, no domain prefix
